description: Assiette de servitude I4 relative aux distributions d'énergie électrique - PUY-DE-DÔME - 2014 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by carto.datara.gouv.fr. Public utility easements (SUPs) are administrative limitations on the right to property, they are established for the benefit of public persons, concessionaires of public works or public works, private persons engaged in an activity in the public interest. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Easement Base I4 for Electric Power Distributions — PUY-DE-DÔME — 2014" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include AMENAGEMENT URBANISME, ELECTRICITE, RESEAU ENERGIE DIVERS, DDT 63, ASSIETTE SERVITUDE, RESTREINT. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
